interface.start_conversation_desc: Interact with your installed language models directly in the Command Center.
interface.need_inspiration: Need some inspiration? Enable chat suggestions in settings to get started with example prompts.
interface.type_placeholder: Type your message to {{name}}... (Shift+Enter for new line)
interface.rewrite_not_installed: The {{model}} model is not installed. Consider <1>downloading it</1> for improved retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) performance.
interface.download_rewrite_body: This will dispatch a background download job for <1>{{model}}</1> and may take some time to complete. The model will be used to rewrite queries for improved RAG retrieval performance. Note that download is only supported when using Ollama. If using an OpenAI API interface, please download the model with that software.

chat_main.clear_history_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all chat sessions? This cannot be undone.
chat_main.stream_failed_error: Failed to generate response. Please verify the AI model is running.
chat_main.switch_model_desc: Changing models will start a new chat session. Your current conversation is saved in the sidebar.

collections_manager.modal_desc: Rename or remove collections. Removing a collection doesn't delete any files — they're simply moved back to Uncategorized so you can re-sort them.
collections_manager.no_collections: No collections yet. Assign a file to a collection from the Knowledge Base table to create one.

kb_prompt_banner.index_started_msg: {{name}} will index your existing content. You can track progress in the Knowledge Base panel.
kb_prompt_banner.index_failed_msg: Could not start indexing. Try again from the Knowledge Base panel.
kb_prompt_banner.maybe_later_msg: Your content stays unindexed for now. You can opt in any time from the Knowledge Base panel.
kb_prompt_banner.save_choice_failed: Could not save your choice. Try again.
kb_prompt_banner.explanation: When indexed, {{name}} can reference them while answering your questions.

nomad_md.modal_subtitle: Custom instructions passed to {{name}} as a system prompt on every chat.
nomad_md.saved_success: NOMAD.md saved. It applies to new messages.
nomad_md.tip_storage: Tip: this file is also stored on disk at <1>storage/NOMAD.md</1> and can be edited directly.

models_page.header_desc: Manage language models, configure runtime options, and set parameters for {{name}}.
models_page.not_installed_title: {{name}}'s dependencies are not installed. Please install them to manage AI models.
models_page.not_installed_desc: Go to System Settings > Easy Setup or Supply Depot to install AI components.
models_page.gpu_not_accessible_desc: An NVIDIA GPU was detected on this system, but {{name}} is not currently utilizing it. Running on GPU significantly accelerates response times.
models_page.reinstall_confirm_body: This will recreate the {{name}} container with GPU support enabled. Your downloaded models will be preserved. The service will be briefly unavailable during reinstall.
models_page.reinstall_in_progress_msg: {{name}} is being reinstalled with GPU support. This page will reload shortly.
models_page.suggestions_desc: Show prompt suggestions on empty chat threads to inspire conversations.
models_page.flash_attn_desc: Enable flash attention optimization in Ollama for lower VRAM usage and faster processing.
models_page.auto_thinking_desc: Enable reasoning by default on models that support chain-of-thought thinking.
models_page.remote_desc: Connect to an external Ollama instance on your local network instead of running locally.
models_page.no_models_installed: No language models currently installed. Browse the available catalog below.
models_page.delete_model_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
